message:
As we think about preparedness, let’s take a moment to appreciate the simple joys of being ready. We’ve recently come across some practical resources that remind us how low-tech fun can be part of our emergency planning. ✨ Whether it’s gathering supplies for our kits or finding new ways to engage our families, it’s all about embracing the process together. 

How about we share our own tips? What’s your favorite low-tech trick for staying prepared?
